message.essentialcraft5.wind_wish.not_wi.en: The wind doesn't answer you... (be Windbound first)
message.essentialcraft5.wind_wish.not_wi.zh: 风没有回应你……（先受风之眷顾）

message.essentialcraft5.wind_wish.desc.c.en: take me up high: stay at Y %s or above under the open sky for %s seconds.
message.essentialcraft5.wind_wish.desc.c.zh: 带我去高处吧——在 Y %s 以上、头顶露天的地方待满 %s 秒。
陪我跑一会儿吧——疾跑 %s 格。

message.essentialcraft5.wind_wish.desc.t.en: I want to see %s: walk into one.

message.essentialcraft5.wind_wish.desc.f.en: fall like a feather: drop from %s blocks or more and land unhurt (water and slow falling both count).
message.essentialcraft5.wind_wish.desc.f.zh: 像羽毛一样落下来吧——从 %s 格以上落下，落地不受伤（落进水里、缓降都算）。

message.essentialcraft5.wind_wish.desc.m.en: dance under the moon: jump %s times in a row at night under the open sky.
message.essentialcraft5.wind_wish.desc.m.zh: 在月光下跳舞吧——夜里在头顶露天的地方连跳 %s 次。

message.essentialcraft5.wind_wish.desc.a.en: visit another world: spend %s minutes in a different dimension.
message.essentialcraft5.wind_wish.desc.a.zh: 去别的世界看看吧——到另一个维度待满 %s 分钟。

message.essentialcraft5.wind_wish.desc.g.en: ride on me: glide %s blocks on elytra without landing.
message.essentialcraft5.wind_wish.desc.g.zh: 乘着我飞吧——用鞘翅连续滑翔 %s 格，中途别落地。

message.essentialcraft5.wind_wish.desc.t.en: listen to the thunder with me: stand under the open sky in a thunderstorm for %s seconds.
message.essentialcraft5.wind_wish.desc.t.zh: 陪我听雷吧——雷雨里在头顶露天的地方站满 %s 秒。

message.essentialcraft5.wind_wish.active.en: The wind is still waiting: %s (%s / %s, about %s min left)
message.essentialcraft5.wind_wish.active.zh: 风还在等：%s（%s / %s，还剩约 %s 分钟）

message.essentialcraft5.wind_wish.active.en: The wind is still waiting: %s (about %s min left)
message.essentialcraft5.wind_wish.active.zh: 风还在等：%s（还剩约 %s 分钟）

message.essentialcraft5.wind_wish.cooldo.en: The wind hasn't thought of a new wish yet... (ask again in about %s s)
message.essentialcraft5.wind_wish.cooldo.zh: 风还没想好下一个心愿……（约 %s 秒后再问）

message.essentialcraft5.wind_wish.restin.en: The wind remembers what you have done for it. Ask again once its true name is fully revealed.
message.essentialcraft5.wind_wish.restin.zh: 风记着你替它做过的事。等风之真名全显出来，再来问它吧。

message.essentialcraft5.wind_wish.done.en: The wind circles you happily. Thank you!
message.essentialcraft5.wind_wish.done.zh: 风欢快地绕着你转了一圈：谢谢你！

message.essentialcraft5.wind_wish.expire.en: The wind's wish has drifted away...

message.essentialcraft5.wind_wish.swappe.en: The wind takes the potion and thinks it over...

message.essentialcraft5.wind_wish.no_wis.en: The wind has no wish for you right now (sneak and right-click the rune with empty hands to ask)
message.essentialcraft5.wind_wish.no_wis.zh: 风现在没有托付给你的心愿（两手空着潜行右键符文问它）

message.essentialcraft5.wind_wish.no_oth.en: The wind can't think of another wish right now
message.essentialcraft5.wind_wish.no_oth.zh: 风一时想不出别的心愿

message.essentialcraft5.wind_rune.needs_.en: The wind doesn't know you yet: only the Windbound can imbue this
message.essentialcraft5.wind_rune.needs_.zh: 风还不认得你：这件东西要受风之眷顾的人来注风

message.essentialcraft5.wind_tablet.need.en: The wind is still waiting for you to fulfil its wishes (%s / %s)...
message.essentialcraft5.wind_tablet.need.zh: 风还在等你替它完成心愿（%s / %s）……

tooltip.essentialcraft5.wind_horn.en: Hold to blow at night under the open sky: summons an Archmage with %s escorts
tooltip.essentialcraft5.wind_horn.zh: 夜里在露天处按住吹响：召来一只大法师和 %s 个随从

tooltip.essentialcraft5.wind_horn.rules.en: Windbound only. Used up when blown; only your own kills drop loot
tooltip.essentialcraft5.wind_horn.rules.zh: 要受风之眷顾；吹一次就没了，只有你亲手打倒的才有掉落

message.essentialcraft5.wind_horn.not_wi.en: The wind doesn't answer the horn... (be Windbound first)
message.essentialcraft5.wind_horn.not_wi.zh: 风没有回应号角……（先受风之眷顾）

message.essentialcraft5.wind_horn.peacef.en: On Peaceful, no mage will come
message.essentialcraft5.wind_horn.peacef.zh: 和平难度下不会有法师来

message.essentialcraft5.wind_horn.wrong_.en: The wind can't hear the horn here (Overworld or Hoanna only)
message.essentialcraft5.wind_horn.wrong_.zh: 风在这里听不见号角（只在主世界和海纳尔）

message.essentialcraft5.wind_horn.no_sky.en: Blow it under the open sky
message.essentialcraft5.wind_horn.no_sky.zh: 要在头顶露天的地方吹

message.essentialcraft5.wind_horn.not_ni.en: The mages only come at night

message.essentialcraft5.wind_horn.cooldo.en: The wind is still resting (about %s s)

message.essentialcraft5.wind_horn.busy.en: The mages you called are still here

message.essentialcraft5.wind_horn.no_spa.en: No place nearby where the mages could land (blocked, or not yours to build on)
message.essentialcraft5.wind_horn.no_spa.zh: 附近没有法师能落脚的地方（被挡住，或是你没有权限的地方）

message.essentialcraft5.wind_horn.blown.en: The horn's call drifts away on the wind...

message.essentialcraft5.wind_horn.arrive.en: The wind brings an Archmage to you!

message.essentialcraft5.wind_horn.fizzle.en: The wind couldn't bring the mages; it gives the horn back
message.essentialcraft5.wind_horn.fizzle.zh: 风没能把法师带来，号角还给了你

message.essentialcraft5.wind_horn.gone.en: The mages you called blew away with the wind
message.essentialcraft5.wind_horn.gone.zh: 你叫来的法师随风散去了
